summary: A 4-op FM and subtractive synth built around a chance arpeggiator: hold a chord and a CHANCE control decides how many steps play.
features: 50 sounds in eight kinds, plus a RANDOM mode that makes new ones
Arp HOLD; 32-step sequencer transposed from the keys
Chords, effects and an oscilloscope view; USER presets
Arp and sequencer notes sent over USB MIDI; MIDI notes in
Keeps its own presets; doesn't read other firmwares' projects or samples

headings: mighty arp for the m-vave fm-1
